name.en: Sinful Spoils of the Winter Raven's Forest
name.ja: <ruby>白<rt>はく</rt></ruby><ruby>鴉<rt>あ</rt></ruby>の<ruby>森<rt>もり</rt></ruby>の<ruby>罪<rt>ざい</rt></ruby><ruby>宝<rt>ほう</rt></ruby>

text.en: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by placing 1 Level 1 FIRE Monster Card from your face-up field or GY on the bottom of the Deck. You can only Special Summon "Sinful Spoils of the Winter Raven's Forest" once per turn this way. When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can return this card to the hand, then target 1 monster in the face-up field or either GY; place it face-up in its owner's Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell. You can only use this effect of "Sinful Spoils of the Winter Raven's Forest" once per turn.
